reported_control_lines.text: The narrative comparison reports edge RMS values of 0.971, 1.724, and 1.953 px for three selected nearby clasts, versus 0.2422 px for the target. It reports normalized Laplacian variances of 1.64e-4, 2.45e-4, and 2.98e-4, versus 8.02e-5 for the target. These are reported local comparisons; the audit has not independently regenerated the selections or measurements and does not treat them as a regional geological distribution.
